description: MetaBlooms OS boot-root repair and verification policy. Governs the pre-work gate that ensures the live OS root at /mnt/data/Metablooms_OS is boot-sound before any governed work proceeds.

blocking_checks.description: scripts/mpp/mpp.sh must exist in the live root. Its absence means the boot entrypoint is missing and the runtime cannot execute governed operations.
blocking_checks.error_message: BLOCKED: /mnt/data/Metablooms_OS exists but scripts/mpp/mpp.sh is missing

blocking_checks.description: bash scripts/mpp/mpp.sh turn-boot must exit 0 after mpp.sh is confirmed present.
blocking_checks.error_message: BLOCKED: mpp.sh exists but turn-boot failed — root is structurally unsound

receipt_requirements.description: A boot receipt must be written in the same run that performs the repair. It cannot be carried over from a prior session.

repair_strategy.description: Extract the full OS archive to a staging location, verify mpp.sh is present and turn-boot passes, then promote to the live root. Write receipt before proceeding.

description_of_failure_class: directory_existence_treated_as_runtime_soundness — /mnt/data/Metablooms_OS exists does NOT imply the runtime is bootable. This policy prevents that false assumption.
